quote: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 6 [NRS-484B-297-6], pedestrians walking along highways where sidewalks are not provided shall walk on the left side of those highways facing the approaching traffic.

activation.condition: A pedestrian walks along a public highway where a qualifying sidewalk is not provided; subsection 6 sidewalk-obstruction detour is inapplicable.

exceptions.description: A sidewalk traveler may detour around an obstruction under subsection 6; applicability requires separate source review and is not presumed in this no-sidewalk cell.
exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 6 [NRS-484B-297-6]

obligation.description: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 6 [NRS-484B-297-6], pedestrians walking along highways where sidewalks are not provided shall walk on the left side of those highways facing the approaching traffic.

timing.description: Observe original pedestrian position and heading, highway boundaries and approaching traffic route throughout longitudinal walking.
